stem:
Meena adds a few drops of iodine solution to a small piece of boiled potato at home, and it turns blue-black. Which of the following statements about this starch test is incorrect ( )
A. Iodine solution turns blue-black when it comes in contact with starch
B. The blue-black colour shows that starch is present in the potato
C. Any colour change in a food test proves that the nutrient we expected is present
D. A food item that contains no starch will not turn blue-black with iodine

options.text: Iodine solution turns blue-black when it comes in contact with starch
The blue-black colour shows that starch is present in the potato
Any colour change in a food test proves that the nutrient we expected is present
A food item that contains no starch will not turn blue-black with iodine

teacher.key_rationale: The starch test result is specific: only a blue-black colour with iodine indicates starch. Statement C is incorrect because a colour change must match the specific test and expected result; an arbitrary colour change does not prove the presence of whichever nutrient was expected. A, B and D correctly describe the starch test.
